meta.title: Dream Labs — AI business process automation & premium web design
meta.description: Dream Labs builds AI business process automation for sales, customer care, accounting and reporting, plus premium websites, landing pages, video and packaging. Transparent pricing in VND.
meta.ogTitle: Dream Labs — AI business process automation
meta.ogDescription: AI systems that automate sales, customer care, accounting and reporting, plus premium websites, landing pages and video. Studio based in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.
meta.orgDescription: Dream Labs delivers AI business process automation (sales, customer care, accounting, reporting) and designs websites, landing pages, video and packaging. Based in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.

t.Website nhẫn cưới tông kem và vàng hồng,: Ivory and rose-gold wedding ring website with arched frames: a ring builder that redraws metal, setting, stone shape and carat live, a wedding band pair with separate sizes, a ring-size tool and fitting bookings.
t.Website kim cương nền đen, chữ serif lớn: Black editorial diamond website with oversized serif type: filter the collection by type, inspect pieces with a mouse or touch loupe and pinch zoom, choose metal and the 4Cs with live pricing, book a private viewing.
t.Mời hẹn xem ngọc trai Akoya, South Sea,: Book a pearl viewing for Akoya, South Sea and Tahitian strands: pick pearl type, size and a strand length drawn on a neck silhouette, choose the clasp for a live price, and zoom into the nacre.
t.Website vàng ta thủ công tông sơn mài đỏ: Handcrafted Vietnamese gold website in lacquer red, black and gold with a slowly turning bronze-drum motif: lotus and cloud motifs drawn on scroll, pricing by gold purity and chỉ/phân weight, ring and bangle sizing, close-up zoom and bookings.
t.Mời đeo thử đồng hồ cơ concept VT-01: ki: Try-on invitation for the concept VT-01 mechanical watch: hands tick in real time, dial, case and strap restyle the drawing, and rings, cuffs and cufflinks show your engraved initials live before a boutique booking.
t.Website showroom xe sang phong cách Thụy: A Swiss-style luxury car showroom site in wide type: configure paint, wheels and interior with live pricing, compare declining-balance and fixed-payment loans, compare two models and book test drives in Ho Chi Minh City or Hanoi.
t.Landing thuê xe sang có tài xế tông ngà: An ivory and midnight-navy chauffeur landing page with an arched hero photo: pick airport transfer (Tan Son Nhat, Noi Bai), wedding car or hourly hire plus a car class for an instant estimate, then book.
t.Website câu lạc bộ siêu xe kiểu poster đ: A poster-style supercar club site in black and acid lime with giant type and a scroll-driven marquee: event calendar filtered by month and type, seat reservations, three membership tiers compared and an application form.
t.Landing ra mắt SUV hybrid tông xanh tím: A glowing violet launch page for a hybrid SUV with a launch countdown: choose a trim, showroom, date and open time slot on a live calendar, get a booking code, plus a reference on-the-road price table.
t.Website xưởng detailing tông than chì và: A graphite-and-copper detailing studio site with viewfinder-style photo frames: pick car size and ceramic, PPF or interior packages for price and turnaround time, drag a before/after slider by mouse or touch, and book.
t.Website maison nước hoa niche tông giấy: Niche perfume house website in ivory paper and brick red, styled like a pressed-flower specimen book: filter eight scents by family, an animated note pyramid for each scent, 10/50/100 ml sizes and a saved cart.
t.Landing nước hoa đo riêng tông đỏ rượu v: Bespoke perfume landing in oxblood and rose copper: compose top, heart and base notes with a limit per tier, a note pyramid that redraws instantly, name the scent, pick a size for a live price and book an atelier consultation.
t.Landing bộ sưu tập mùa mưa tông xám đá v: Rainy-season collection landing in slate and moss: rain falling over the hero image, scroll storytelling through four scents with time-based note pyramids, size picker, mini cart and discovery-set signup.
t.Landing quiz mùi hương tông tím khói và: Scent-finder landing in lilac and citron: a six-question tap-card quiz with progress bar and back button, scoring by fragrance family, one main match and two alternates with note pyramids, size picker and cart.
t.Website quà tặng nước hoa khắc tên tông: Engraved perfume gift website in bottle green and brass: pick a scent and size, preview engraving live on an SVG bottle, cap or box in three typefaces, then choose box, card and delivery date and add to the gift cart.
t.Trợ lý concierge hỏi ba câu về sở thích,: A concierge assistant asks three questions about taste, recommends the right house scent, then books a private salon fitting.
t.Mỗi sáng AI rà sổ khách thân thiết: nhắc: Every morning, AI reviews the loyalty book: bag-care reminders, private collection invitations, and sensitive cases handed to a real person.
t.Lễ tân AI nhận lịch xem đồng hồ tại bout: An AI receptionist books boutique viewings: pick a reference, choose a private slot, and the piece is waiting on the tray.
t.AI đọc tin nhắn thuê du thuyền, tự điền: AI reads charter enquiries, fills in the request, matches the right yacht and drafts a preliminary quote in seconds.
t.Khách hỏi mua penthouse từ website, Zalo: Penthouse enquiries from the website, Zalo and hotline are scored by AI, ranked hot, warm or cold, and pushed straight into the CRM.
t.Bảng điều khiển gom doanh số ba boutique: A dashboard combining sales from three boutiques; AI writes a morning briefing and suggests next actions for the brand owner.
t.Mở đặt trước chai nước hoa bản giới hạn: Pre-orders for a limited run of 618 bottles: countdown, choice of size and cap, and engraving previewed live on the bottle.
t.Mở bán 144 chiếc túi theo lời mời: khách: An invitation-only release of 144 bags: clients choose leather, clasp and size on the illustration, then request an invitation.
t.Thu khách thuê du thuyền riêng: chọn tuy: Private charter lead capture: choose a route on the map, guests and extras for an instant estimate.
t.Bán thẻ giờ bay phi cơ riêng: chọn hạng: Selling private jet hour cards: choose aircraft class and hours, see range on the map and the hourly rate update instantly.
t.Đăng ký xem nhà mẫu cho 13 căn penthouse: Show-unit viewings for 13 penthouses: pick a floor and unit to see the plan, area and price, then book a slot.
t.Giữ suất siêu xe đặt riêng 34 chiếc: cấu: Reserve one of 34 bespoke supercars: paint, wheels, calipers and interior change live on the illustration.
t.Landing mở bán biệt thự nghỉ dưỡng bên v: Launch page for bayside resort villas: location map, floor plans for each villa type and a price-list request form.
t.Landing tuyển hội viên cho một phòng tập: Membership landing page for a gym: class schedule, plans and a trial-session sign-up form.
t.Quảng cáo nước hoa 8 giây: chai thủy tin: An 8-second fragrance ad: an arched glass bottle drawn in SVG, light gliding across it, 377 scent particles bursting into a swirl, serif type appearing letter by letter. Seamless loop to black.
t.Phim ra mắt túi cho Reels/TikTok: hình t: A bag launch film for Reels/TikTok: circle and rectangle build the body, stitching and handle draw themselves, the clasp glints, three leather colors cycle, ending on the title and release date.
t.Logo animation 7 giây: vành phút bung từ: A 7-second logo animation: the minute track unfurls from a point, five gears mesh at true ratios, the hands spin and stop at 10:10, then morph into the V of the logo as light sweeps across the wordmark.
t.Kinetic typography 7 giây cho giày thủ c: 7-second kinetic typography for handmade shoes: five big-type scenes cut to the beat, "slow" typed letter by letter, "far" leaving a trail, a 212-stitch counter, and a derby silhouette drawn in line.
t.Infographic giải thích 4 chặng chế tác:: An infographic of four crafting stages: selection, a 57-facet cut, 38 hours of hand-setting, finishing. The rough stone morphs into facets, figures count up, a progress bar follows each step. Illustrative figures.
t.Teaser sự kiện 8 giây: hoàng hôn trên vị: An 8-second event teaser: sunset over the bay, a yacht gliding past, water shimmering in perspective, a compass turning to its heading, specs counting up before the title and invitation.
t.Dream Labs 3D Studio — Sáu vật thật: Dream Labs 3D Studio — Six real objects
t.Phim sản phẩm 3D 17 giây: sáu món đồ qué: A 17-second 3D product film: six objects 3D-scanned from real items (Poly Haven, CC0) on a bronze-trimmed stone plinth, the camera orbiting and pushing in, light gliding over brass, ceramic, porcelain and wood; product names appear on the beat. Built entirely in Three.js in the browser.
t.Dream Labs thiết kế trọn dòng nước hoa:: Dream Labs designed the full fragrance line: a thick glass block with a rounded reservoir, polished stone cap and metal collar, type printed on glass, a textured lift-off box with foil stamping, plus 3D imagery for three scents.
t.Tên dòng và số mùi in thẳng lên mặt chai: Line name and scent number printed directly on the bottle
t.Đá vân mài bóng trên đai kim loại: Veined stone polished to a shine on a metal collar
t.Khoang chứa bo tròn nằm giữa lòng kính: A rounded reservoir set inside the glass
t.Dream Labs thiết kế dáng túi hộp vai vòm: Dream Labs designed a dome-shouldered box bag with a curved flap, round disc clasp, hand-stitched rolled handle and metal rings in four leathers, plus a rigid box, dust bag and foil-stamped logo.
t.Dream Labs thiết kế phom giày mũi nhọn g: Dream Labs designed a pointed-toe last with a 9.5 cm heel, low-cut topline, slim leather sole and gold-plated heel cap, shown in three leathers, with a shoebox and insole logo.
t.Gót mảnh bọc cùng chất liệu thân giày: Slim heel covered in the upper's material
t.Dream Labs thiết kế mặt số tia mặt trời: Dream Labs designed a sunburst dial with small seconds at 6 o'clock, applied indices and hands, a 40 mm round case, hand-stitched leather strap, logo and velvet-lined lacquer box across four editions.
t.Dream Labs thiết kế mẫu nhẫn đá chủ bốn: Dream Labs designed a four-prong solitaire with pavé shoulders, a leather-wrapped clamshell box with metal trim and velvet lining, and a rising-sun mark foil-stamped inside the lid.
t.Dream Labs thiết kế dáng chai vai rộng đ: Dream Labs designed a broad-shouldered, heavy-based bottle, paper labels for three age statements, a neck capsule, a mountain-and-cloud mark and an engraved wooden case for an oak-aged single malt.
t.Dream Labs thiết kế cốc nến, nắp kim loạ: Dream Labs designed the vessel, metal lid, typographic label and lift-off gift box for three scents, each in its own material: glossy black porcelain, matte ivory porcelain and amber glass.
t.Dream Labs thiết kế bộ ba bao bì dưỡng d: Dream Labs designed a three-piece skincare range: dropper serum, cream jar and pump lotion in frosted glass with metal caps, direct-printed labels and a gift set box, in three colorways.
t.Sản phẩm thật quay trên bàn xoay: nhẫn k: A real product filmed on a turntable: white-metal ring, round center stone in four prongs, pavé shoulders. Illustrative footage from Pexels; the 360 viewer is built by Dream Labs. The source video covers about 150 degrees, so this one rocks back and forth.
t.Bình đồng đúc chạm vân sóng ở cổ và chân: A cast brass vase with wave engraving at neck and foot. 3D-scanned from a real object (Poly Haven, CC0); plinth, studio lighting and 360 viewer by Dream Labs. Drag to turn it and see every angle as if in hand.
t.Ba ly đồng thau chân cao, viền chạm hoa: Three tall brass goblets with engraved rims and mirror-polished bowls. 3D-scanned from real objects (Poly Haven, CC0); plinth, studio lighting and 360 viewer by Dream Labs. Drag to turn them and see every angle as if in hand.
t.Bình gốm men trắng vẽ lam kín thân, đế v: A white-glazed vase painted all over in blue, with a blue-rimmed foot. 3D-scanned from a real object (Poly Haven, CC0); plinth, studio lighting and 360 viewer by Dream Labs. Drag to turn it and see every angle as if in hand.
t.Tượng ngựa sứ trắng men bóng tung vó trê: A glossy white porcelain horse rearing on a wooden base. 3D-scanned from a real object (Poly Haven, CC0); plinth, studio lighting and 360 viewer by Dream Labs. Drag to turn it and see every angle as if in hand.
t.Đồng hồ để bàn vỏ gỗ sẫm, mặt số La Mã v: A dark wood desk clock with a brass-rimmed Roman dial. 3D-scanned from a real object (Poly Haven, CC0); plinth, studio lighting and 360 viewer by Dream Labs. Drag to turn it and see every angle as if in hand.
t.La bàn đồng thau nắp lật, mặt kính, kim: A brass flip-lid compass with glass face and magnetic needle. 3D-scanned from a real object (Poly Haven, CC0); plinth, studio lighting and 360 viewer by Dream Labs. Drag to turn it and see every angle as if in hand.
t.Reels 9:16 giới thiệu nước hoa, xem khôn: A 9:16 fragrance Reel that works with sound off: word-by-word animated captions, five scenes cut to the beat, speed ramps on close-ups, whip-pan and flash transitions, teal–orange grade and an end card with the release date. 3D footage built in code.
t.TVC 16:9 cho túi da, bản cắt 8 giây: cận: A 16:9 TVC for a leather bag, 8-second cut: close-ups of stitching and clasp, handle details, a whip-pan into the wide shot, letter-by-letter title, letterbox framing, a warm late-afternoon grade and a brand end card. 3D footage built in code.
t.Video lookbook dọc 8 giây: dáng người mẫ: An 8-second vertical lookbook: a backlit model walking, fast–slow–fast speed ramps, product close-ups, a three-way split for three leather tones, slow-motion steps, type frames and an end card. Footage built in code.
t.Video unboxing vuông 7,5 giây: hộp sơn m: A 7.5-second square unboxing: a lacquer box opening on a slowing speed ramp, close-ups of dial and strap, animated captions highlighting word by word, a four-step progress bar, flashes on the beat and a numbered end card. 3D footage built in code.
t.Video tour penthouse 9 giây: bốn cảnh má: A 9-second penthouse tour: four dolly shots through the living room, lounge and dining table before flying out to the city view, whip-pan joins, lower-thirds for each zone, a floor plan tracking the camera, and a teal–orange dusk grade. 3D footage built in code.
t.Recap sự kiện 8 giây: 9 nhát cắt theo nh: An 8-second event recap: 9 cuts on the beat, a rack focus onto the signage, a slow-motion toast, flash montage, confetti, time-stamped lower-thirds, a cinematic blue–gold grade and a closing logo. Footage built in code.

t.Website xưởng túi da thủ công dàn trang: Website for a handmade leather atelier in an editorial layout: an index of eight bag shapes, six leathers switching across the set, detail drawers and private workshop appointments.
t.Website nhà đóng giày đo chân tông xanh: Website for a bespoke shoemaker in moss green and brass: six styles with per-pair leather switching, a nine-measurement drawing, a twelve-week process and fitting appointments.
t.Website nhà chế tác đồng hồ cơ đơn sắc,: A monochrome, big-type website for a mechanical watchmaker: a dial running on real time, an animated movement diagram, six references with three strap options and a full-screen spec sheet.
t.Website nhà kim hoàn tông xanh đêm và án: Website for a jeweler in midnight blue and ice: a hand-drawn diamond sparkling in the hero, a carat and color-grade tool, eight designs in three metals, and private salon appointments.
t.Website nhà champagne độc lập trên nền g: Website for an independent champagne house on ivory paper and wine red: a shelf of eight cuvées with hand-drawn bottles, three bottle sizes with prices, cellar cards with tasting notes and an allocation request.
t.Website xưởng rang cà phê thủ công: bảng: Website for a craft coffee roastery: beans by roast batch, roast-curve charts and brew recipes for each method. A mid-range template for small shops.
t.Website mỹ phẩm thuần thực vật: bốn sản: Website for plant-based skincare: four products, ingredient tables and routines by skin type. A mid-range template, light and easy to update yourself.

Tự động hóa quy trình doanh nghiệp bằng AI là gì?
What is AI business process automation?

Là dùng AI và các công cụ tự động để làm thay những việc lặp đi lặp lại: trả lời khách, tạo đơn, nhập liệu, đối soát, nhắc việc, làm báo cáo. Nhân viên chỉ xử lý phần cần con người quyết định, nên doanh nghiệp vận hành nhanh hơn và ít sai sót hơn.

It means using AI and automation tools to handle repetitive work: answering customers, creating orders, data entry, reconciliation, reminders and reports. Your staff only handle what needs a human decision, so the business runs faster with fewer errors.
Doanh nghiệp nhỏ có cần tự động hóa không?
Does a small business need automation?
Có, và thường lợi nhất. Gói Khởi động từ 5.000.000đ tự động hóa một quy trình tốn thời gian nhất, ví dụ tiếp nhận và phân loại khách hàng từ Zalo, triển khai trong 5 đến 7 ngày.

Yes, and small businesses often gain the most. The Starter package, from 5,000,000 VND ({fx:5000000}), automates your most time-consuming workflow, such as taking in and qualifying customers from Zalo, and goes live in 5 to 7 days.
Hệ thống tự động hóa kết nối được với phần mềm nào?
Which software can the automation connect to?
Zalo OA, Facebook Messenger, website, Google Sheets, Gmail, Google Drive, các CRM và phần mềm bán hàng, kế toán có API. Dream Labs dùng n8n, Make hoặc lập trình riêng tùy quy mô và yêu cầu bảo mật.

Zalo OA, Facebook Messenger, your website, Google Sheets, Gmail, Google Drive, and any CRM, sales or accounting software with an API. Dream Labs uses n8n, Make or custom code depending on scale and security needs.
Dữ liệu doanh nghiệp có an toàn không?
Dữ liệu nằm trong tài khoản và hệ thống của doanh nghiệp. Gói Doanh nghiệp có thể triển khai trên máy chủ riêng, phân quyền theo vai trò và không đưa dữ liệu nội bộ ra ngoài khi không cần.
Your data stays in your own accounts and systems. The Enterprise package can run on a private server with role-based access, and internal data never leaves unless it has to.
Một website mất bao lâu để hoàn thành?
How long does a website take?
Gói Cơ bản 7–10 ngày, Chuyên nghiệp 14–21 ngày, Cao cấp 30–45 ngày tùy số trang và tính năng. Lịch chi tiết được chốt ngay sau buổi khám phá.
Essential takes 7–10 days, Professional 14–21 days and Premium 30–45 days, depending on pages and features. A detailed schedule is agreed right after the discovery call.
Đặt cọc 50% khi ký hợp đồng, 50% còn lại khi nghiệm thu. Dự án trên 30 triệu chia 3 đợt 40 / 30 / 30.
50% deposit on signing, 50% on acceptance. Projects over 30,000,000 VND are paid in three instalments: 40 / 30 / 30.
Tôi được chỉnh sửa bao nhiêu lần?
How many revisions do I get?
Mỗi gói ghi rõ số vòng chỉnh sửa. Sửa lỗi kỹ thuật trong thời gian bảo hành luôn miễn phí và không tính vào số vòng.
Each package states its number of revision rounds. Technical fixes during the warranty period are always free and don’t count towards them.
Dream Labs có viết nội dung và chụp ảnh không?
Does Dream Labs write copy and shoot photos?
Có. Gói Chuyên nghiệp trở lên gồm viết nội dung chuẩn SEO. Chụp ảnh sản phẩm và quay phim được báo giá riêng theo buổi.
Yes. Professional packages and above include SEO copywriting. Product photography and filming are quoted separately per session.
Các dự án trên trang này có phải của khách hàng thật không?
Are the projects on this page for real clients?
Chưa. Các thương hiệu gắn nhãn Concept là dự án do Dream Labs tự nghĩ và tự dựng để bạn thấy đúng tay nghề: website chạy thật, video thật, demo AI bấm thử được.
Not yet. Brands labeled Concept are projects Dream Labs imagined and built itself so you can see the craft first-hand: working websites, real video and AI demos you can try.
Tư vấn miễn phí, phản hồi trong 24 giờ.
Free consultation, reply within 24 hours. Prefer English? Use the form or email us; Zalo and phone work too.
